first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: snow-covered competition ski course
entities.identification: A broad white competition snow surface with gentle rounded undulations, occupying the main foreground.

entities.name: blue route markings on the snow surface
entities.identification: Blue lines, curved bands, and localized colored patches adhering to the competition snow surface.

entities.name: protective facilities along the edge of the course
entities.identification: Light-colored barriers, red net fencing, and black and red advertising barriers arranged along the image-left side of the visible ski course.

entities.name: snow-covered coniferous forest
entities.identification: A cluster of dark-colored coniferous trees outside the protective facilities, with generally conical crowns and snow-covered branches.

entities.name: blue-covered course equipment
entities.identification: A cyan-blue, nearly rectangular covered main body behind the protective barriers, with a white numeral-shaped marking on the front.

entities.name: Object N
entities.identification: A gate consisting of two thin orange-red poles and an orange-red banner with a black panel and white letters, which, after being approached, passes by on the image-right side.

entities.name: tips of the red skis
entities.identification: The front ends of bright red, narrow, elongated skis visible at the lower edge in first-person view; two are visible in the final segment.

entities.name: gray-blue sky
entities.identification: A low-contrast gray-blue sky background above the outlines of the tree crowns and slopes.

entities.name: snow-covered hillside outside the course
entities.identification: The white undulating slope outside the protective facilities on the image-left side and the lower-contrast outline of a more distant hillside.
